## Road Events

<p align="right"><strong><a href="#page_1">🔝</a> <a name="page_12">12</a></strong></p>

Road events occur when the party travels between locations. Draw one road event card and resolve it.

### Boat Events

Boat events occur when traveling by sea.

## Monster Movement

Once a monster has found a focus and identified its path, it performs its abilities in order. A monster moves only when its ability card lists movement, which grants movement points equal to its base movement stat plus the listed modifier.

<img alt="Focus Diagram" src="focus.png"> explains the focus example.

<div class="table-responsive">
| Roll | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1-3 | Calm seas |
| 4-6 | Storm |
</div>

<pre>Resolve one movement point at a time.</pre>
